name: Divine Agent (Warpriest Archetype)
body:
War is not only fought on the battlefield in open honorable combat. Competent war also needs scouting, subterfuge and sometimes quiet killing of enemies. This is where the divine agent comes in. They bring the powers of their faith but use it to help them hunt and root out their enemies.

Skills: A divine agent gains Bluff, Disguise, Escape Artist, Intimidate and Stealth as class skills, but they lose Handle Animal, Ride, Survival and Swim. This alters the legendary warpriest’s class skills.

Weapon and Armor Proficiency

The divine agent has the same proficiencies as a rogue, though they still have proficiency with the favored weapon of their deity or faith.

This replaces the weapon and armor proficiencies of the legendary warpriest.

Hidden Faith (Ex)

At 1st level, the divine agent gains a bonus on Disguise and Bluff checks to hide their affiliation to their deity or faith equal to their class level and they gain Stealthy as a bonus feat. This replaces the blessing gained at 1st level.

Sneak Attack (Ex)

At 3rd level, the divine agent gains the sneak attack ability, as the unchained rogue class feature. If he already has sneak attack from another class, the extra damage from the classes that grant sneak attack stack for the purpose of determining the sneak attack’s extra damage dice. This extra damage is 1d6 at 3rd level and increases by 1d6 every 3 levels thereafter. This ability replaces weapons of the faithful.

Enthrall (Sp)

Beginning at 4th level, the divine agent can cast enthrall as a spell-like ability by expending two uses of fervor. This ability replaces the ability to heal or damage all creatures in an aura, though they can still heal or damage with a touch. This ability modifies fervor.

Hide in Plain Sight (Ex)

At 13th level, a divine agent can use the Stealth skill even while being observed. As long as he is within 10 feet of an area of dim light, a cult leader can hide himself from view in the open without anything to actually hide behind. He cannot, however, hide in his own shadow.

This ability replaces the blessing gained at 13th level.
